motivation: The complete one-forced-edge schedule returned 1,670 labeled E=2 endpoints but only the two already-known complement classes. This follow-up changes the move architecture by forcing a second, explicitly non-repairing edge before tabu repair.

independent_review.terminal_state_recount: E=0, E=1, and E=2 are exact-recounted after the last permitted move as well as before every move

first_barrier_schedule.eligible_edge_rule: force every edge outside the seed conflict-edge union, plus every conflict-union edge whose exact post-flip objective exceeds four
first_barrier_schedule.exact_replay: recount the graph after every first forced edge

second_barrier_schedule.eligible_edge_rule: from the once-forced graph, exclude the first edge and every edge in the union of the current forbidden-five-set edges; retain candidates with exact post-flip objective at most 80
second_barrier_schedule.non_repairing_invariant: because an eligible second edge lies in no current conflict, its exact objective delta must be nonnegative
second_barrier_schedule.exact_replay: recount the graph after every selected second forced edge
second_barrier_schedule.initial_tabu: both forced edges are tabu at the start of repair

acceptance: all 53 seeds independently recount to E=3 or E=4
all 22 known E=2 inputs expand to exactly 1,892 distinct labeled neutral-cycle states
the first-barrier schedule exactly matches the accepted 47,675-case schedule and every first forced graph passes exact replay
every first forced graph has at least one eligible second edge and every selected second forced graph passes exact replay
any E=1 graph is immediately exact-recounted, written to the frozen E1 output, printed, and stops the run with exit code 11
any E=0 graph is immediately exact-recounted, written to the frozen discovery output, printed, and stops the run with exit code 10 for two independent Ramsey checks
if no E=0 or E=1 is found, every exported E=2 graph is independently recounted and quotient-classified before a novelty claim
the result binds the frozen source, binary, inputs, parameters, and output hashes
stopping_rule: Run the complete frozen two-forced-edge schedule once. Stop early only for a replay failure, resource-safety failure, E=1 near-construction, or E=0 construction.
claim_boundary: The two forced schedules are exhaustive only relative to the 53 retained classes and the stated edge rules. Every subsequent repair trajectory is heuristic. Failure to find E=0 or E=1 proves no nonexistence statement.
